Contact

Contact

The quickest way to reach the right place.

Email

Write to admin@dappgo.com. We read every message. The address is the same for readers, app users, businesses and the press.

Report an error in a report

Send the address of the page, the figure you believe is wrong, and where you saw a different value. The session date and the short payload code at the top of the page help us find the exact data. How we handle corrections is described in the editorial policy.

Help with an app

The support page has answers to common questions about the TW Stocks, US Stocks and Options Explorer apps, and forms for feedback. For Number RPG, use the Number RPG support page.

Privacy requests

To ask about or delete personal data, follow the steps in the privacy policy or email the address above.

Follow DappGo

We post daily report summaries on Threads, Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.

We cannot give personal investment advice or comment on individual trades.

DappGo publishes research and educational material only. Nothing on this page is investment advice, a recommendation, or an offer to buy or sell any security. Prices can be delayed and may contain errors; check them against your broker or the exchange before acting. Past results do not predict future results.
